audit: Old URL /pages/size-guide now 404s; guide is at /shopping/size-guides.html. Stored chart was UK 6–16 with letters one size off (XXS = UK 6, M = UK 12); Whistles' letters are dual sized (XS = UK 4–6, S = 8–10, M = 12–14, L = 16–18, XL = 20–22). Hips were 4–7 cm too small. UK 6 hips 86 -> 90.5; UK 12 bust 91 -> 93, waist 71 -> 75, hips 96 -> 103; UK 16 bust 101 -> 103, waist 81 -> 85, hips 106 -> 113. UK 4, 18, 20 added from the Body chart; UK 22 from the dual-size XS–XL table. US from the conversion chart (UK 4 shows US "00", which is ambiguous with the chart's zero-padding, so UK 4 has no US; UK 22 has no conversion row). EU removed: the chart gives France and Italy columns, not EU. Notes corrected (range was 'XXS (UK 6) through XL (UK 16)').

Old URL whbm.com/content/pages/size-guide no longer loads; the official chart is at whitehouseblackmarket.com/store/page/size-chart (also opened from product-page 'Size Chart'). Used the Dresses 'Regular Sizes' chart because it is the one with bust, waist and hip together (Tops gives 'high hip'; bust and waist are identical to Dresses). Was 4 letter rows with UK/EU conversions WHBM does not publish; now 11 US numeric rows 00–18 with letters as altLabel (XS = US 0–2, M = US 8–10, XL = US 16–18). Inch originals in _in; the page's own cm view has rounding/typing errors (e.g. 24" waist shown as 58.42 cm), so cm were recomputed at exactly 2.54. Stored M bust 88 -> 92.7 (US 8) / 95.3 (US 10), hips 94 -> 99.1 / 101.6; L bust 94 -> 99.1 / 102.9, hips 100 -> 105.4 / 109.2. UK/EU removed (not published). Petite and long charts not included.

Old URL /content/size-guide 404s; guide is at /womens-curve-size-chart. Official chart is UK 10–40 (stored 16–28) with cm printed by the brand (no conversion needed). Waist and hips were 2–3 cm too small in the middle sizes and the top sizes were too big: UK 16 waist 84 -> 87, hips 108 -> 111; UK 20 bust 114 -> 113, waist 96 -> 98, hips 120 -> 122; UK 24 bust 126 -> 125, waist 108 -> 110, hips 132 -> 134; UK 26 bust 133 -> 131, waist 115 -> 116; UK 28 bust 140 -> 137. Notes and fit text corrected ('exclusively plus-size, sizes 16–40' -> 10–40).
